items.text: Add an FAQ that names the plan with scheduled texts and link it to pricing.

Which plan includes scheduled text alerts?
Scheduled alerts are included on [the Standard plan and above]. Write the message in Gmail or Outlook, pick a send time, and every phone in the group gets it as a normal text at that time. Staff install nothing, and replies come back to your inbox. See the pricing page for the current plans and limits.
